We're a team that's looking forward to getting good on this project.

(Frigoberto)
summary: We created an app concept in Canva and built a game in Microsoft MakeCode Arcade, each with its own content. In our App concept, we included old NASA machines that were forgotten after they stopped working, along with the vital parts of an app; in our game, we addressed how this old machinery could be used in the future.
details:
The game we made works in this way: You find old NASA hardware across Mars, the Moon, and outer space, and on each piece of NASA hardware collected, there is the story behind it and how it can be used in the future. We used coding blocks in MakeCode Arcade and made sure every single visible detail in-game was made by us.

When making this game, we considered the use of characters to play, but this idea was later scrapped.
